g.title: MSA_QSP
g.text: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA) — Mechanistic QSP Map

Oligodendroglial α-synuclein (GCI) → myelin failure → central autonomic + striatonigral + olivopontocerebellar neuronal loss → a baroreflex loop broken CENTRALLY while postganglionic terminals survive

Drug layer: midodrine · droxidopa (± carbidopa interaction) · fludrocortisone · atomoxetine · pyridostigmine · yohimbine · octreotide · desmopressin · levodopa/carbidopa · ubiquinol · verdiperstat · anti-α-synuclein mAb / ASO
